fields.label: Before you start
fields.text:
ONE RECORD PER PRODUCTION DAY, for the product covered by the site's HACCP plan. Add a row for every oven load as it comes out, and write the readings at the oven rather than at the end of the shift. A critical control point that was checked and not written down was, as far as anyone else can tell, not checked.

CCP 1 IS THE KILL STEP. The bake destroys pathogens that come in with the liquid egg, Salmonella among them. The critical limits below are the HACCP plan's.

IF A LIMIT IS NOT MET, the load is not released. Section 3 says what happens to it.

WHEN THE DAY IS DONE, sign Section 4 and leave the entry as a draft. It is reviewed, the verification is signed, and the reviewer submits it.

fields.label: Product
fields.help: The product covered by the HACCP plan.

fields.label: CCP 1 critical limits (HACCP plan)
rows: At least 180°F at the end of the bake
Probe thermometer in the centre of one unit
Each batch - NOT YET PERFORMED, see Section 2

fields.label: Oven loads
fields.help: One row per load, written when the load comes out of the oven. A rebake is a new row with the same lot code.

fields.label: Internal product temperature - not yet performed
fields.text:
The HACCP plan's third limit for CCP 1 is an internal product temperature of at least 180°F at the end of the bake, probed in the centre of at least one unit per batch. That check is not performed on this site today.

Leave the column blank unless a probe reading was actually taken, and never write a figure that was not measured. Until the probe check is in place, a Pass in Within critical limits means the oven temperature and bake time limits were met - it does not mean the 180°F limit was, and this record does not claim it.

fields.label: Internal temperature on this day
options: Not probed - probe check not yet in place
Probed - a reading is recorded against every load

sections.title: 3. If a limit was not met

fields.label: What to do
fields.text:
OVEN TEMPERATURE BELOW 350°F, OR BAKE TIME UNDER 27 MINUTES: do not release the load. Return it to the oven and complete a full bake cycle, and record the rebake as a new row in Section 2 with the same lot code.

IF THE LOAD CANNOT BE REBAKED, or a probed internal temperature is below 180°F after a full bake: put the product on Hold and tag it on FRM-702 under FSQM-018. The SQF Practitioner decides whether it is rebaked or destroyed.

EVERY DEVIATION is investigated for its cause and recorded on FRM-007 under FSQM-009. Held product is not released on FRM-701 until its disposition is recorded.

Yes - each one is recorded below

fields.label: Deviations
fields.help: Required for every deviation. Leave empty only where the answer above is None.

fields.label: Monitored by (production operator)
fields.statement: I took the readings recorded above at the time of each load, and recorded them as taken.

fields.label: Who verified this record
fields.help: FSQM-017 Part 5: a person does not verify their own monitoring where a second qualified person is available. Where one is not, say so here.
options: Someone other than the operator who took the readings
No second qualified person available - verified by the operator

fields.label: Verified by
fields.statement: I have reviewed this record against the CCP 1 critical limits, and every deviation on it has a recorded action.
